# Senior Interview Question Bank

<p>Choose one domain, one group and one question. The question stays visible; open its guidance after your own attempt. English is canonical and Vietnamese preserves the same IDs, assumptions, source references and assessment meaning.</p>

<p>234 numbered source prompts + 4 source scenarios = 238 source units. 10 duplicate pairs consolidate into 228 canonical questions across 46 existing catalog groups and 13 domains. Unprocessed source units: 0.</p>

[Question coverage and source mapping](coverage.md) · [Curriculum](../curriculum/index.md)

## A small daily practice session

- Pick one question whose prerequisite you can explain. Predict or draft an answer without opening the guidance.
- Explain one causal mechanism using a small code trace, diagram or truthful example. Test a failure or changed assumption with evidence.
- Open the guidance, identify one specific gap and try again. Give a direct 30-second answer, then defend it in 90 seconds and one follow-up.
- For a full 30–45-minute lesson, send the prompt below to your repo agent. Only an actual attempt can support feedback or durable completion; this page does not schedule reviews.

> Write today’s focused lesson in English using one question from this bank. Follow agent/SKILL.md, check prerequisites and all delivered objectives, and preserve the source question ID. Do not infer completion from generated content.

<p>Questions come from the preserved source notes. Reframing, assessment intent, senior signals and rubrics are editorial interpretations, not verified model answers or universal interviewer expectations. Follow-ups and the combined production exercise are agent additions. Reading this bank creates no learning record, score, completion or review schedule.</p>
